name: goat-doodle-notes
description: Doodle Notes · Гар зураас: keeps the phone footage exactly as filmed and adds thick white or black hand-drawn marker lines that draw themselves on, placed round the real thing in the frame: a ring round the product, a line under the price, arrows, stars, hearts and short handwritten Mongolian notes written word by word, plain captions of what is said, and full-screen paper pages where the marker acts out the point (a ticked list, one big word, a before and after, the line that matters), built on HyperFrames. Renders a 1080x1920 MP4 for Reels/TikTok.
